name: Retrofête
band_note: mean of blouse entry $248 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band
why: Sequin and beaded party dresses, jumpsuits, denim and evening tops, dresses around $500–$800, sold through its own store and site, department stores and many independent boutiques.
origin: Founded in 2018 by Ohad Seroya; Aviad Klin.

quote.q: Retrofête blurs the line between day and night, creating a life-of-the-party aesthetic within each design.

opview: “Retrofête blurs the line between day and night, creating a life-of-the-party aesthetic within each design.” — Retrofête (house), About, retrofete.com

doors.note: One own store (99 Spring St, SoHo). /pages/store-locators is a wholesale list. Brand mark RETROFÊTE.
